rule_text: Do not flag specific numeric values (tolerances, time limits, masses, distances, timing constraints, accuracy tolerances, environmental parameters) as lacking traceability when they are already stated in the requirement, even if traceability is not explicitly documented.
Do not propose replacing technical specifications with operational context descriptions when the technical specification is the actual requirement constraint.
Do not expand vague or incomplete requirements with specific details from context notes when those details introduce new information not present in the original requirement.
Prefer maintaining requirement references over expanding them when the expansion would create redundancy across the requirement set.
Do not flag 'able to' when the expert's concern is about notes or TBD items rather than the modal verb construction itself.
